query:
WITH RECURSIVE target_playlists AS (
            SELECT id
            FROM playlists
            WHERE id = ANY($1)
            UNION ALL
            SELECT p.id
            FROM playlists p
            JOIN target_playlists tp ON p.parent_id = tp.id
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT m.id AS "id: MediaId"
        FROM media m
        WHERE m.room_id = $2
          AND (
              m.id = ANY($3)
              OR m.playlist_id IN (SELECT id FROM target_playlists)
          )
        ORDER BY m.id
